name: @mnemosyne-plugins/mnemo-archipel
description: Un CRM personnel organique et sobre conçu pour le TDAH, luttant contre l'oubli des relations par la résonance cognitive.

descriptionI18n.fr: Un CRM personnel organique et sobre conçu pour le TDAH, luttant contre l'oubli des relations par la résonance cognitive.
descriptionI18n.en: An organic, understated personal CRM designed for ADHD, fighting the forgetting of relationships through cognitive resonance.
descriptionI18n.es: Un CRM personal orgánico y sobrio diseñado para el TDAH, que combate el olvido de las relaciones mediante la resonancia cognitiva.

_permissions: vault:read and vault:write keep each contact in this app's own sandbox vault. model:infer reads a brain dump to extract facts. agenda:write puts a follow-up you chose into the Mnemosyne Agenda, on a press, so it rings with this window closed; it cannot read, move or delete an appointment.
